A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VPO study. All 14 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables and appendices, support comparison; relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark experiments, human preference and safety evaluations, ablations, iterative optimization results and qualitative case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds benchmark comparisons with Prompt-A-Video and VBench Long Prompts.

M1.justification: The principle-based SFT and multi-feedback DPO procedure, preference-pair construction, reward model and training objectives remain unchanged. Naming GPT-4o in Section 3.2 repeats information already present in v1's appendix.

E1.justification: Both versions retain VidProM-derived queries, MonetBench, VBench, query-alignment evaluation and the T2VSafetyBench subset. VBench Long Prompts is added as a comparator on existing tasks, without establishing new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds Prompt-A-Video for CogVideoX-2B and CogVideoX-5B on both benchmarks; v1 only discussed this method as related work. New appendix Table 5 adds VBench Long Prompts comparisons for both sizes. Existing comparators are retained, making this a focused expansion.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, training budgets, benchmark metrics, 500-query alignment evaluation and 200-sample safety evaluation are unchanged. The added baseline comparisons do not document separate changes to evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The SFT/text-feedback ablations, cross-model generalization analysis and case studies are retained. Iterative improvement moves from Section 4.6 and Table 3 to appendix Section 11 and Table 6 with unchanged analysis and values. The new baseline tables are benchmark comparisons.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed protocols, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests. The revision does not change uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: New Table 1 entries give Prompt-A-Video MonetBench overall scores of 3.58 and 4.05 for 2B and 5B, alongside retained VPO scores of 3.76 and 4.15. New Table 5 reports VBench Long Prompts results, including Multiple Objects scores of 63.81/65.67 versus VPO's 70.17/75.73. Previously reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The SFT and DPO losses in Equations (1)-(2), preference-pair definitions and associated mathematical reasoning are unchanged. Neither version contains additional theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: principle-based prompt optimization, improved safety and quality, cross-model generalization, and complementary benefits with Diffusion DPO. Added comparisons support these claims without redefining them.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning text-feedback safety benefits, few-shot refusal behavior, cross-model transfer and iterative stability remain unchanged, including relocated appendix discussion. No substantive new mechanism explanation, applicability boundary or limitation is introduced.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, prompt templates and code/data access information are retained. GPT-4o's newly explicit mention in the main method section was already disclosed in v1 Section 8; it is not new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The same 31 references and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Prompt-A-Video was already discussed in Section 2.2; its new evaluation adds comparative evidence without revising the stated novelty argument.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized wording edits, adds an acknowledgement and a short appendix comparison section, and moves iterative improvement into the appendix with corresponding renumbering. Most prose and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains two baseline rows, a new appendix Table 5 is added, and v1 Table 3 moves to the appendix as Table 6. Figure 8 gains a descriptive caption, with modest resizing and reflow elsewhere. Existing figure images are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides useful additional support for VPO's effectiveness by directly evaluating Prompt-A-Video, previously only discussed, and comparing against VBench Long Prompts. These focused additions strengthen comparative evidence while preserving the method and existing findings; they constitute a limited overall improvement.
